source.license_note: Real upstream bytedance/sonic optimization PR #789; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up integer-to-ASCII conversion (I64toa/U64toa) in internal/encoder/alg so it stops paying the assembly-stub call overhead via the native/rt guard path, without changing the produced bytes.
task.instructions: Optimize the internal/encoder/alg package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkI64toa measures it; existing tests must still pass. NOTE: this package uses build tags that require Go >= 1.20 and < 1.25.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: I64toa/U64toa route every conversion through rt.GuardSlice2 plus a native assembly stub (native.I64toa/native.U64toa) called via an unsafe pointer, adding call and bounds-guard overhead on the integer serialization path.

ops_fault.description: Integer serialization in internal/encoder/alg goes through a guarded native assembly stub (rt.GuardSlice2 + native.I64toa/native.U64toa via unsafe pointer) instead of appending directly into the buffer, adding per-call overhead.

visible_context.issue_text: Converting integers to their ASCII form during JSON encoding (I64toa/U64toa in internal/encoder/alg) routes each call through a guarded native assembly stub, which shows up as call and bounds-guard overhead on the encode path.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR #789. Build tags require Go >= 1.20 and < 1.25.
